name: Verigate Authority
tagline: Give your AI agent an action. Verigate decides if it has the authority.
description: Describe a payment or transfer in plain language. Anna AI extracts the request fields and explains the result, while Verigate's deterministic policy engine returns the signed ALLOW/WARN/BLOCK decision. The AI cannot authorize or execute a transaction. The signed decision receipt can be inspected and verified independently.
